scenario.summary: An opportunistic attacker exploited a misconfigured third-party VPN gateway using compromised credentials to gain access to a bank's internal network. The intruder performed broad network scanning, brute-force attempts against administrator accounts, and scraped internal documentation before attempting to execute code via a WSUS vulnerability, which was blocked by endpoint security.

meta.rationale: Start with external-facing VPN gateways. Focus on accounts that log in from geographically unusual locations or at anomalous times, especially those that do not trigger an MFA challenge.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker has gained initial access through a misconfigured VPN gateway lacking multi-factor authentication and is brute-forcing administrator accounts across internal systems to escalate privileges.

hunt.name: VPN Entry and Internal Brute Force
hunt.description: This hunt examines the identity plane for signs of third-party risk and credential abuse. It starts by scoping for successful VPN sign-ins where multi-factor authentication (MFA) was not enforced. It then fans out to identify internal brute-force patterns targeting administrative accounts and correlates these with rare account lifecycle changes, such as password resets or account creations. An agent weighs the combined evidence to distinguish between automated noisy scanners and a successful intrusion originating from a compromised VPN session.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, service_name, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 1 AND (mfa = 'false' OR mfa IS NULL) AND (LOWER(service_name) LIKE '%vpn%' OR LOWER(dst_endpoint_name) LIKE '%vpn%' OR LOWER(metadata_product) LIKE '%vpn%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify successful logins to VPN services that did not use or report multi-factor authentication.
config.expected_signal: Rows naming the VPN gateway and the users who successfully logged in without MFA. Silence proves no MFA-less logins were recorded for gateways reporting to the lake.

primitive_config.label: VPN Sign-ins Without MFA
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, service_name, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 1 AND (mfa = 'false' OR mfa IS NULL) AND (LOWER(service_name) LIKE '%vpn%' OR LOWER(dst_endpoint_name) LIKE '%vpn%' OR LOWER(metadata_product) LIKE '%vpn%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Rows naming the VPN gateway and the users who successfully logged in without MFA. Silence proves no MFA-less logins were recorded for gateways reporting to the lake.

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, device_hostname, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS unique_accounts, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 2 AND (LOWER(actor_user_name) LIKE '%admin%' OR LOWER(actor_user_name) LIKE '%root%' OR instr(',' || '{{admin_account_patterns}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(actor_user_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip, device_hostname HAVING attempt_count > 20
config.description: Find source IPs attempting to guess passwords for multiple administrative accounts.
config.expected_signal: A single internal IP address generating dozens of authentication failures across different admin names. Silence suggests no automated guessing was visible on these hosts.

primitive_config.label: Internal Brute Force Against Admins
primitive_config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, device_hostname, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS unique_accounts, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 2 AND (LOWER(actor_user_name) LIKE '%admin%' OR LOWER(actor_user_name) LIKE '%root%' OR instr(',' || '{{admin_account_patterns}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(actor_user_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip, device_hostname HAVING attempt_count > 20
primitive_config.expected: A single internal IP address generating dozens of authentication failures across different admin names. Silence suggests no automated guessing was visible on these hosts.

config.content: SELECT user_name, activity_name, device_hostname, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS distinct_actors, MIN(time) AS first_change FROM hb_account_change WHERE activity_id IN (1, 4) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY user_name, activity_name, device_hostname
config.description: Baseline account changes to identify rare password resets or creations that could indicate persistence.
config.expected_signal: A password reset or account creation performed by an unusual actor. Baseline noise will show routine resets; anomalous entries will have low actor counts.
